notes.title: Dingletopia Version 2.0
notes.content:
Dingletopia 2.0 is here! It has been enhanced with the following:

- Performance improvements.
- Alternate battle sprites.
- Sound mixing improvements.
- Dmurf explosions don't hurt other Dmurfs.
- White Flag upgraded, do not lose morale or loyalty for fleeing.
- Graphics clean up.
- Landmines...
- Interface graphical enhancements.
